claims.claim: Arnona objection (hasaga) must be filed with the arnona manager within 90 days of receiving the payment demand (Local Authorities (Objection to Arnona Assessment) Law 1976, section 3). The manager must respond within 60 days (section 4). An appeal (erur) to the appeals committee is filed within 30 days of the manager's decision (section 6); further appeal goes to the Administrative Court.

claims.claim: Senior (vatik) arnona discount is by pension/income status, not age band: 25% (discretionary) for a recipient of an old-age/survivors/work-injury pension with no income test; 30% (mandatory) income-tested where household income is up to the national average wage (about NIS 13,566/month as of January 2026, updated annually); up to 100% for a senior who also receives an income supplement (hashlamat hachnasa) within the income limit. claims.claim: Effective 1 January 2026 the income-tested arnona discounts were reformed: eligibility is computed on the 12-month average income only (the 3-month option removed), against a per-capita threshold table indexed to the minimum wage and household size, with certain Bituach Leumi benefits (child allowances, old-age/survivors pensions) excluded from counted income; eligibility widened from roughly 740,000 to 840,000 households while the top band stays 90%.
